g.text: But plugging in LLM embeddings gives little
The common practice: cache one embedding per item, add it as a feature
QA. The ranker needs click and purchase similarity.
Different usage → should be far apart.
A cached embedding is a fixed input. No gradient
reaches it, so it cannot adapt to the ranking task
or to the business as it drifts.
"Our goal is not to recommend look-alike items users have already seen,
but to discover new items of interest expanded from their historical behaviors."
QARM V2 (arXiv:2602.08559), §1 (toothpaste / ointment example and quote)
